## 📅 캘린더 — 일별 commit 분포

```{=html}
<div class="viz-container">
  <div style="margin-bottom: 12px;">
    <label for="org-filter" style="font-weight:500; margin-right:8px;">Org 필터:</label>
    <select id="org-filter" style="padding:4px 8px; border:1px solid var(--aa-snu-border); border-radius:4px;">
      <option value="all">전체 (All)</option>
      <option value="snuconnectome">snuconnectome</option>
      <option value="Transconnectome">Transconnectome</option>
      <option value="neurox-org">neurox-org</option>
    </select>
  </div>
  <div id="calendar"></div>
</div>
```

Single-color teal heatmap. Org 필터로 단일 조직 활동 패턴 분리 가능. 마감일 직전 burst는 색 농도로 즉시 식별.

## 🎯 계획 예산 대비 실제 투입

```{=html}
<div class="viz-container">
  <div id="wp-budget"></div>
</div>
```

MASTER_PLAN의 WP별 예산 배분(WP1 40% · WP2 15% · WP3 25% · WP4 10% · WP5 10%)과
같은 기간 실제 commit 비중을 나란히 놓았습니다.

**제안서는 독립 버킷입니다.** 제안서를 쓰는 일은 그 제안서가 하겠다고 한 연구를
하는 일과 다른 활동이라, 어느 WP 안에 넣으면 아직 일어나지 않은 성과를 그 WP의
실적으로 계상하게 됩니다. 계획 %가 없는 이유도 같습니다 — 40/15/25/10/10은
수주한 연구에 대한 배분이지 수주 활동에 대한 배분이 아닙니다.

격차에 판정색을 쓰지 않았습니다. 초기에 인프라(WP5)가 몰리는 것처럼 계획된 궤적이
있는 WP에서는 격차가 곧 실패를 의미하지 않기 때문입니다. **미분류 막대가 큰 동안에는
이 비교 전체를 잠정으로 읽으셔야 합니다.**

## 🌊 스트림 — 학문 도메인별 활동 흐름

```{=html}
<div class="viz-container">
  <div id="stream"></div>
</div>
```

연구 분야(brain foundation model · neural field modeling · agentic AI ·
clinical translation · human/animal neuro · education · infra)별 월간 누적 흐름.
분류 근거는 `data/taxonomy/`에 있고, 출처(curated / rule / unclassified)는
`data/pub/taxonomy_coverage.json`에서 확인할 수 있습니다.

## 📦 도메인 분포

```{=html}
<div class="viz-container">
  <div id="category-bars"></div>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<script type="module">
import * as Plot from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@observablehq/plot@0.6.16/+esm";
import * as d3 from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7/+esm";

const commits = await fetch("data/pub/commits_slim.json").then(r => r.json());

// ─── KPI tiles ────────────────────────────────────────────
const distinctRepos = new Set(commits.map(c => `${c.org}/${c.repo}`)).size;
const distinctWeeks = new Set(commits.map(c => {
  const d = new Date(c.author_date);
  const onejan = new Date(d.getFullYear(), 0, 1);
  const week = Math.ceil(((d - onejan) / 86400000 + onejan.getDay() + 1) / 7);
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-W${week}`;
})).size;
const lastCommit = commits[0]?.author_date?.slice(0, 10) ?? "—";

document.getElementById("kpi-row").innerHTML = `
  <div class="kpi-tile"><div class="label">Total commits</div><div class="value">${commits.length}</div></div>
  <div class="kpi-tile"><div class="label">Repos active</div><div class="value">${distinctRepos}</div></div>
  <div class="kpi-tile"><div class="label">Active weeks</div><div class="value">${distinctWeeks}</div></div>
  <div class="kpi-tile"><div class="label">Last commit</div><div class="value" style="font-size:1.1rem;">${lastCommit}</div></div>
`;

// ─── Calendar heatmap (single-color teal + org filter) ────
// Build full date domain to show empty days too (better visual density)
const dateExtent = d3.extent(commits, c => new Date(c.author_date));
const dayDomain = [];
if (dateExtent[0]) {
  const start = d3.utcMonday(dateExtent[0]);
  const end = d3.utcMonday.offset(d3.utcMonday(new Date()), 1);
  for (let d = new Date(start); d < end; d = d3.utcDay.offset(d, 1)) {
    dayDomain.push(new Date(d));
  }
}
const weekStrings = [...new Set(dayDomain.map(d => d3.utcFormat("%Y-W%V")(d)))].sort();

// Choose week labels — show first week of each month
const monthMarkers = new Map();
for (const w of weekStrings) {
  const sampleDay = dayDomain.find(d => d3.utcFormat("%Y-W%V")(d) === w);
  if (sampleDay) {
    const monthKey = d3.utcFormat("%Y-%m")(sampleDay);
    if (!monthMarkers.has(monthKey)) {
      monthMarkers.set(monthKey, { week: w, label: d3.utcFormat("%b '%y")(sampleDay) });
    }
  }
}
const tickWeeks = new Set([...monthMarkers.values()].map(m => m.week));

function renderCalendar(orgFilter = "all") {
  const filtered = orgFilter === "all" ? commits : commits.filter(c => c.org === orgFilter);
  const byDay = d3.rollup(filtered, v => v.length, c => c.author_date.slice(0, 10));

  // Fill all days in domain so empty cells appear
  const data = dayDomain.map(d => {
    const key = d3.utcFormat("%Y-%m-%d")(d);
    return {
      date: d,
      count: byDay.get(key) ?? 0,
      weekday: d.getUTCDay(),
      week: d3.utcFormat("%Y-W%V")(d),
    };
  });

  const target = document.getElementById("calendar");
  target.innerHTML = "";
  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width: 980,
    height: 200,
    marginLeft: 60,
    marginRight: 20,
    marginBottom: 40,
    color: {
      scheme: "blues",
      type: "linear",
      legend: true,
      label: "commits/day",
      domain: [0, Math.max(1, d3.max(data, d => d.count) || 1)],
    },
    x: {
      axis: "bottom",
      label: null,
      domain: weekStrings,
      tickFormat: w => (tickWeeks.has(w) ? monthMarkers.get(d3.utcFormat("%Y-%m")(dayDomain.find(d => d3.utcFormat("%Y-W%V")(d) === w)))?.label : ""),
      ticks: weekStrings.filter(w => tickWeeks.has(w)),
    },
    y: {
      tickFormat: d => ["일", "월", "화", "수", "목", "금", "토"][d],
      label: null,
      domain: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 0],  // Mon-first ordering
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.cell(data, {
        x: "week",
        y: "weekday",
        fill: "count",
        title: d => `${d3.utcFormat("%Y-%m-%d")(d.date)}\n${d.count} commit${d.count === 1 ? "" : "s"}`,
        inset: 1,
      }),
    ],
    style: {
      background: "transparent",
      fontFamily: "var(--aa-font-en)",
    },
  });
  target.appendChild(chart);
}

renderCalendar();
document.getElementById("org-filter").addEventListener("change", e => renderCalendar(e.target.value));

// Colours come from the pipeline (data/pub/palette.json) rather than hex
// literals here, so the domain, WP, and category axes cannot drift apart
// between the Python side and the pages.
const palette = await fetch("data/pub/palette.json").then(r => r.json());

// ─── Stream: monthly flow by scientific domain ────────────
// Stacked, not overlaid. With 8 series and a curve, unstacked areas crossed
// each other into a decorative wave that could not be read.
const byMonthDomain = d3.rollups(
  commits,
  v => v.length,
  c => d3.timeFormat("%Y-%m")(new Date(c.author_date)),
  c => c.domain ?? "unclassified",
);
const streamData = [];
byMonthDomain.forEach(([month, rolls]) => {
  rolls.forEach(([domain, n]) => {
    streamData.push({ month: new Date(month + "-01"), domain, n });
  });
});

const domainOrder = Object.keys(palette.domain)
  .filter(d => streamData.some(s => s.domain === d));

const streamChart = Plot.plot({
  width: 980,
  height: 320,
  marginLeft: 50,
  marginRight: 150,
  x: { type: "time", label: "month" },
  y: { label: "commits", grid: true },
  color: {
    domain: domainOrder,
    range: domainOrder.map(d => palette.domain[d]),
    legend: true,
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.areaY(streamData, Plot.stackY({
      x: "month",
      y: "n",
      z: "domain",
      fill: "domain",
      order: domainOrder,
      curve: "monotone-x",
      tip: true,
    })),
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
  ],
  style: { background: "transparent", fontFamily: "var(--aa-font-en)" },
});
document.getElementById("stream").appendChild(streamChart);

// ─── Domain totals ────────────────────────────────────────
const domainCounts = d3.rollups(commits, v => v.length, c => c.domain ?? "unclassified")
  .map(([domain, n]) => ({ domain, n }))
  .sort((a, b) => b.n - a.n);

const barChart = Plot.plot({
  width: 980,
  height: 300,
  marginLeft: 180,
  marginRight: 70,
  x: { label: "commits" },
  y: { label: null, domain: domainCounts.map(c => c.domain) },
  color: {
    domain: Object.keys(palette.domain),
    range: Object.values(palette.domain),
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(domainCounts, { x: "n", y: "domain", fill: "domain", tip: true }),
    Plot.text(domainCounts, {
      x: "n", y: "domain", text: d => d.n,
      dx: 8, textAnchor: "start", fontWeight: 600,
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([0]),
  ],
  style: { background: "transparent", fontFamily: "var(--aa-font-en)" },
});
document.getElementById("category-bars").appendChild(barChart);

// ─── WP: planned budget vs actual effort ──────────────────
// The single most decision-relevant chart here: MASTER_PLAN_6YR allocates
// 40/15/25/10/10 across WP1-5, and this shows where the time actually went.
// Neutral colours on purpose — a gap is not automatically a failure (WP5 front-
// loads), and colouring it red/green would assert a judgement the data can't make.
const wpTotal = commits.length;
const wpActual = d3.rollup(commits, v => v.length, c => c.wp ?? "unbound");
const wpRows = [];
for (const wp of palette.wp_order) {
  const planned = palette.wp_budget_pct[wp];   // undefined for PROP and unbound
  const actual = 100 * (wpActual.get(wp) ?? 0) / wpTotal;
  if (planned === undefined && actual === 0) continue;
  const label = `${wp === "unbound" ? "" : wp + " "}${palette.wp_labels[wp]}`;
  if (planned !== undefined) wpRows.push({ wp, label, kind: "계획", pct: planned });
  wpRows.push({ wp, label, kind: "실제", pct: actual });
}
const maxPct = Math.max(...wpRows.map(r => r.pct), 40);

// Grouped bars via fy faceting. Two rows share a WP, so plain y would let
// Plot's implicit stack lay the actual bar on top of the planned one — making
// 2% look like it reached 42%. (dx/dy are constants in Plot, not channels;
// offsetting per row that way yields translate(…,NaN).)
const wpLabels = [...new Set(wpRows.map(r => r.label))];
const wpChart = Plot.plot({
  width: 980,
  height: 340,
  marginLeft: 200,
  marginRight: 60,
  x: { label: "% of commits", grid: true, domain: [0, maxPct + 6] },
  y: { axis: null, domain: ["계획", "실제"], padding: 0.25 },
  fy: { label: null, domain: wpLabels },
  color: { domain: ["계획", "실제"], range: ["#A0A0A0", "#003380"], legend: true },
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(wpRows, { x: "pct", y: "kind", fy: "label", fill: "kind", tip: true }),
    Plot.text(wpRows.filter(r => r.pct > 0), {
      x: "pct", y: "kind", fy: "label", text: d => `${d.pct.toFixed(0)}%`,
      dx: 6, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 11,
      fill: d => (d.kind === "계획" ? "#5A5A6E" : "#003380"),
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([0]),
  ],
  style: { background: "transparent", fontFamily: "var(--aa-font-en)" },
});
document.getElementById("wp-budget").appendChild(wpChart);
</script>
```
